milestones.title: Docker and database foundation
milestones.objective: Compose baseline for web/API/PostgreSQL/worker/Redis, first migrations, health probes and separate document/app-data mounts.
acceptance_criteria: Compose core starts without AI services
Database migration applies idempotently
Document root remains bind-mounted and portable
App health status distinguishes core from optional workers
milestones.notes: Done 2026-10-30. Evidence: `npm run check` (node checks, exit 0); `npm run check:api` (ruff clean, ruff format clean, mypy strict clean on 11 files, pytest 26 passed / 1 skipped in python:3.13-slim); `npm run test:compose` 9 passed (~3 min) against real Docker Compose 5.6.1 / Docker 29.9.2: fresh install without workers or AI, idempotent + concurrent migrations (one alembic row, instance_id unchanged), restart/down-up persistence with byte-identical bind-mounted library, total DB loss leaves documents intact, core failure -> 503 and recovery, optional redis/worker down -> degraded (HTTP 200), security posture (no published db/api ports, non-root, read-only rootfs, no password in logs). Bug found and fixed by the tests: unresolvable Redis host stalled /health ~8s (DNS ignores socket timeouts); optional probes now run under a 1.5s deadline. ADR-001 and ADR-002 accepted by owner; ADR-003 (Compose layout, named volume for Postgres, health semantics) was Proposed at M01 and later accepted by owner. Limitations: CI workflow extended but not executed on GitHub; the non-writable app-data unit test is skipped when run as root in the container; Docker verified on Windows/Docker Desktop only (Linux bind-mount ownership via FILECANOPY_UID/GID is documented, not tested); no Dramatiq jobs yet (heartbeat worker only); health endpoint unauthenticated until M02. CI verification 2026-10-31: GitHub Actions (Linux) passed on PR #1 and on main (check, check:api 72 passed/1 skipped, test:compose 10 passed), resolving the earlier 'CI not run on GitHub' and 'Windows-only Docker' limitations.

milestones.title: Local authentication and first administrator
milestones.objective: Secure first-admin bootstrap, email/password accounts, sessions, login/logout, access throttling, invitation and reset token primitives.
acceptance_criteria: No default admin credentials or open registration
Password hashes and secure session cookies used
Invitation/reset token tested as single-use and expiring

milestones.notes: Done 2026-10-30. Evidence: `npm run check` clean; `npm run check:api` in the pinned python:3.13-slim image: ruff and format clean, mypy strict clean (20 files), 72 passed / 1 skipped (includes the auth suite on in-memory SQLite: no default creds/registration, setup token hashed/one-shot/throttled, Argon2id, cookie flags, enumeration resistance, brute-force throttling per account+ip/account/ip with lockout refusing the correct password, session revocation on logout/password change/admin action, idle+absolute expiry, disabled-account cutoff, CSRF/Origin, invitation/reset single-use/expiry/purpose/replay/hashed at rest, admin authz negatives, no secrets in admin API or audit, 422 does not echo passwords); `npm run test:compose` 10 passed (~3.6 min) on Docker 29.9.2, including new test_auth_stack.py: migration 0002 on PostgreSQL, setup-token flow from the log, login/CSRF/Origin through nginx, invitation replay, logout revocation, throttling keyed on the real client IP forwarded by nginx, no password in logs. Opus 5.5 security review 2026-10-30: no findings at the >80%-confidence bar. Outstanding: ADR-012 Proposed awaiting owner approval. Known limits: lockout counting not strictly atomic under bursts; per-account lockout permits temporary victim lockout; no reset email (needs SMTP, later), no OIDC, no TOTP; health endpoint intentionally unauthenticated for probes. CI verification 2026-10-31: GitHub Actions (Linux) passed on PR #1 and on main (check, check:api 72 passed/1 skipped, test:compose 10 passed), resolving the earlier 'CI not run on GitHub' and 'Windows-only Docker' limitations.

milestones.title: Safe filesystem service and file CRUD
milestones.recommended_claude_code_model: Sonnet 5.5; Opus 5.5 review for race safety
milestones.objective: Build safe filesystem primitives and APIs for list, browse, folder create, upload, download, copy, move, rename with transaction journal.
acceptance_criteria: All file payloads remain real native files
Path escape, overwrite, conflict checks effective
Idempotent and revision-checked operations
Partial failure exposes reconcile status; does not silently lose source
milestones.notes: Done 2026-10-31 (Sonnet 5.5). Evidence: `npm run check` clean; `npm run check:api` ruff/format/mypy strict clean, 200 passed / 1 skipped (new tests/unit/api/test_files.py, 54 tests: real-file CRUD, name validation, listing, 96 MiB streamed round trip, upload limit, atomic write and DB-failure cleanup, no-overwrite for files and directories incl. host-created names, revision checks, interleaved/CAS/stolen-name concurrency, idempotency, uniform 403 matrix, disabled root, symlink/hardlink/FIFO refusal, missing-file reconcile, faked EXDEV cross-device move/copy with verify/DB-failure/source-changed cases, rename rollback and reconcile_needed, crash recovery, route inventory); `npm run test:compose` 14 passed incl. new test_files_stack.py on PostgreSQL behind nginx (5 MiB upload above the old nginx limit, move lineage rewrite, copy, 4 real concurrent renames: exactly one 200). Code: apps/api/app/{storage/files.py,domain/fileops.py,api/files.py}, migration 0004_file_operations, policy/deps.py guards, apps/web/nginx.conf upload location. ADR-013 Accepted. M03 carry-overs resolved: ensure_root_dir before writes; lineage rewrite in the move transaction; hardlinks (st_nlink>1) refused for read/copy, metadata ops allowed; disabled roots block grant admin and are hidden from entry_points; every route policy-guarded. Limits: no delete/trash/undo and no replace-on-upload (later milestones); no Range/conditional download; staging files `.filecanopy-tmp-*` are visible in the destination directory during an upload (M06 import must ignore them); renameat2/hardlink fallbacks and real second-mount EXDEV only faked/untested on NAS; folder rename without renameat2 is check-then-rename. Opus 5.5 race-safety review 2026-10-31: 13 findings; fixed concurrent-move lineage corruption (tree advisory lock + fresh re-read), single-process recovery at startup plus stale-claim release, no-hardlink rename fallback bug, download and copy_tree fd leaks, keyed-retry CAS, undo failures flagged, journal written before each filesystem step, replay access check, ctime in source-unchanged check, writes to missing roots refused. Cross-owner moves: owner decision 2026-10-31 (ADR-013 section 7): future cross-root move = copy + source to the source owner's trash with history (M07); interim M04 rule blocks root-changing moves (422 CROSS_ROOT_MOVE_UNSUPPORTED). Multi-process recovery limit documented. ADR-013 Accepted and M04 signed off by owner 2026-10-31. CI verification 2026-10-31: GitHub Actions (Linux) passed on PR #5 (check, compose app, compose core); merged to main as ebf0c5d.

milestones.title: Initial import and reconciliation
milestones.objective: First-setup import (folder or zip, UI) into an empty shared tree or personal folder, folder upload, watcher + periodic rescan, external filesystem identity reconciliation (ADR-011).
acceptance_criteria: First-setup import of a folder or zip into the empty shared tree (admin) or into the user's own empty personal folder; the window closes on finish, skip or other content; nothing is overwritten
Pre-check shows totals, skipped and unsupported entries, in-import collisions and free space before anything is written
A root on a separately mounted drive is refused, and mounted drives inside a managed folder are listed as unsupported and never entered
Zip extraction refuses path traversal, symlink and encrypted entries, and decompression bombs, within configured limits
Folder upload after setup merges folders and keeps both on file conflicts
External moves/renames reflected or flagged as uncertain
External modifications attributed to external_filesystem
Files removed outside the app shown as missing, never as deleted; mass disappearance suspends the root
milestones.notes: M06a (reconciler, mount refusal, file_event; backend) implemented 2026-10-31 (Sonnet 5.5) on branch m06-import-and-reconciliation; M06b (setup state and window, setup import of folder/zip, folder upload, import tables, setup screens, drag-and-drop UI) not started. Evidence M06a: `npm run check` clean; `npm run check:api` ruff/format/mypy strict clean, 256 passed / 1 skipped (new tests/unit/api/test_reconcile.py, 56 tests: first-scan silent fingerprints, app writes are not external, external create/modify attributed to external_filesystem, editor save-by-rename, out-of-band file and folder rename/move keeping ids, move into a new folder, copy+delete inferred uncertain move, ambiguous twins not linked, no identity across roots, missing/reappear/dismiss with grants removed, mass-change guard and resolve by owner/admin, relocation with and without mtimes, restart scan, 2000-file tree, planned-operation deferral, busy nodes, staging prefix ignored, reconcile_needed resolution, symlink/FIFO/mounted-drive/undecodable/control-character entries never followed, root-on-another-device refusal, case-collision tree, NFD names, network-fs detection and fallback, real inotify watcher, debounced hints, hasher, rescan authorization and rate limit); `npm run test:compose` 15 passed incl. new test_outside_changes_are_reconciled_on_postgres and migration 0002->0005 backfill on PostgreSQL; `npm run test:e2e` 6 passed. Code: apps/api/app/storage/{reconcile,service,watcher,identity,roots}.py, domain/events.py, api/reconcile.py, migration 0005_reconciliation; fileops now stamps fingerprints/hashes, writes created events, applies name_key collisions, returns CONTENT_MISSING/UNSUPPORTED_ENTRY. Design, deviations and limits: docs/milestones/M06a-design-and-plan.md. M06 criteria covered by M06a: external moves/renames (certain or uncertain), external modifications attributed to external_filesystem, missing never deleted with mass-disappearance suspension, root and nested mounted-drive refusal. Remaining for M06b: first-setup import (folder/zip) with plan and free-space check, zip-slip/zip-bomb/encrypted/symlink handling, folder upload, interrupted-import resume, setup window closure (including closing it when a scan finds content), setup screens. Not verified: real second-mount st_dev and NFS/SMB (simulated), inotify on Docker Desktop for Windows bind mounts (periodic rescan is the guarantee), multi-process operation. Opus 5.5 security review of M06a done 2026-10-31 (findings fixed; open items in docs/milestones/M06a-design-and-plan.md); the zip extractor and setup authorization get theirs with M06b. Owner decisions 2026-10-31 (unchanged): import only at first setup into an empty root, no mounted drives as or inside any managed folder, after setup folder upload only (merge, keep both), rescan every 15 minutes, network filesystems allowed with warning and no watcher, unique hash matches become uncertain inferred moves, missing nodes kept until dismissed, unsupported entries shown greyed out. All M06 work stays on one branch and one PR.
